text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I had, like, the worst dream ever last
night.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The ground was sparkling for some
reason, so I
started digging just to see
what was there...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But then I somehow ended up in some
maze and
couldn't find the way out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
My heart was pounding so hard, it woke
me up. I
didn't manage to fall back
asleep after that...
